fact: The World Bank's appraisal-stage document of 11 December 2025 states that health worker strikes over the past two and a half years, with technical limitations and resource shortages, have left gaps in data collection, storage and reporting across DHIS2, and that the proposed IDA and trust-fund programme (appraisal 15 December 2025, approval expected 18 March 2026) will pay for dedicated health data managers in priority regions to ensure data entry, validation and use at facility and district levels.
title: Program Information Document (PID): Senegal Health System Development and Financial Protection Program (CAP santé 2030) (P508171)
